notes.title: Patch Notes For February 2
notes.content:
Fixed level 4.5
 Fixed an issue with colourblind mode not persisting between closing & re-opening
 Fixed an issue with the bonus level button not appearing once you complete all of the levels

notes.title: Shape Palette Release Date Confirmed!
notes.content:
Hello everyone!

We are very excited to announce that Shape Palette is releasing on February 1st at Midnight PST. 

We've been working hard in the background to prepare for the release & feel confident that you will enjoy the puzzles we have come up with.

If you haven't seen it yet then check out our new trailer below & be sure to wishlist the game to be notified when it releases!
